title: Saturating Adder
statement: Design an 8-bit saturating adder that clamps results to the maximum or minimum signed value on overflow. If signed addition overflows positively, output 01111111; if it overflows negatively, output 10000000. No overflow flag is required, only the saturated result.
module_signature: module saturating_adder(input signed [7:0] a, input signed [7:0] b, output reg signed [7:0] y);
behavior: y = a + b unless the signed result overflows.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use behavioral arithmetic that ignores overflow semantics.
hint: Detect overflow from the sign bits of operands and result.
